tokens.name: umber

tokens.name: dune
tokens.usage: Dune. Hard shadows, primary ink, chocolate and mood scenes. Nearest 和色 is 蝋色 rōiro #2b2b2b. Justright on it holds 9.83:1.

tokens.name: santafe

tokens.name: lily
tokens.usage: Lily. Strawberry and visit scenes. Nearest 和色 is 薄柿 usugaki #d4acad. Dune on it holds 6.59:1. Also the accent in the Dune theme, 6.59:1 on dune.
